summary.text: The accumulation of Wu Shuai and his dragonman race, kept in Dragon Palace, becomes Fang Yuan's possession: legacies mostly of enslavement path, the most valuable relating to the Qian Kun Crystal Wall, Censure Peak, and army ant.

claims.text: The accumulation of Wu Shuai and his dragonman race is all kept in Dragon Palace for the future, and Fang Yuan now holds it as his own possession. These legacies are mostly contents related to enslavement path, and the most valuable ones relate to the Qian Kun Crystal Wall, Censure Peak, and army ant. Fang Yuan has basically inherited the legacy of the entire dragonman race.

Wu Shuai suppressed and enslaved Calligraphy Pavilion Lady, gained her Immortal Gu House Calligraphy Pavilion, and found that it was so strong because many Qian Kun Crystal Wall fragments were stored inside. The Qian Kun Crystal Wall is a secluded domain of heaven and earth recorded within The Legends of Ren Zu, but it has always been in a state of fragmentation, and Calligraphy Pavilion’s fragments are only a portion of the original. Censure Peak is already completed, yet it can only be considered on the level of an incomplete secluded domain of heaven and earth, and it is inferior to Refinement Sea in essence. The Qian Kun Crystal Wall and Censure Peak are foundations of information path, a field in which Fang Yuan lacks methods.

Army ant is the true inheritance of Green Ant Ascetic, and after Wu Shuai inherited it, it was his main offensive method. Once the ants grow to a certain number they have terrifying might, enough for one to fight a group of rank eight Gu Immortals alone. Fang Yuan decides army ant will not be practiced now, since building an ant army from scratch would require an immense amount of resources.

Back then, Wu Shuai realized he did not have much chance and arranged for a portion of his inheritance to be preserved in Gu tribe headquarters, in the depths of Eastern Sea. Wu Shuai himself arranged the seal on it, and generations of Gu tribe leaders strengthened it further. Over half a month passes at Gu tribe headquarters before the dusty seal is completely unlocked.

Wu Shuai, Fang Yuan’s dragonman clone, then takes a large grey rock into his immortal aperture and dissects it with the correct method, revealing two Immortal Gu inside. Gu tribe takes the initiative to return Wu Shuai’s inheritance, and the clone thanks the tribe for keeping its word and preserving it until now.

One of the two is the rank eight Immortal Gu Ant Nest, which looks like an ordinary inverted bowl, brown and rough, and is the core Immortal Gu of Green Ant Ascetic that can breed all kinds of army ants. The other is the rank seven information path Immortal Gu Letter Seal, which holds a large amount of content regarding army ants and was used to seal ant nest Immortal Gu. An Immortal Gu must be fed in time or it dies of hunger, so a rank eight Immortal Gu like ant nest is not easy to preserve as an inheritance. The real Wu Shuai covered ant nest Immortal Gu in a thick layer of rock membrane with letter seal Immortal Gu, creating an Immortal Gu rock, and the price was that letter seal Immortal Gu had to be left inside the rock as well. The method is quite effective, as ant nest Gu is still alive after so many years. When the clone dissects the rock, both Immortal Gu are in an extremely weak and hungry state, and Wu Shuai feeds them the food Fang Yuan has prepared while walking back with the Gu tribe immortals.

Army ant is a species created by Green Ant Ascetic, extremely suitable for enslavement path Gu Immortals, and the real Wu Shuai’s most used method was army ant. The queen ant of army ants can breed other ants but cannot breed another queen ant, which is a huge disadvantage. After the dragonman race’s extermination Duke Long sent the order to remove all related things and records, and army ants, implicated because Green Ant Ascetic had been enslaved by Dragon Palace and army ant had become one of the symbols of the dragonman race, disappeared from history.

Gu tribe’s leader says the tribe’s Gu Immortals did covet the inheritance, but the tribe leader back then set a rule that every Gu tribe leader had to first add a seal to it when taking the position, and the tribe always kept fate Gu’s revelation in mind, so the inheritance was preserved until now. For ant nest Immortal Gu to create army ants, immortal essence is only one of the conditions, and specific immortal materials are still required. The Gu tribe leader of back then knew this secret and gathered those materials, and the current leader offers them, but Fang Yuan’s clone refuses and says the conversion of tribe members to dragonmen was done as thanks, with no remuneration discussed.

Wu Shuai, Fang Yuan’s dragonman clone, cultivates enslavement path, and although he has not cultivated for long, he has inherited the inheritance of the dragonman race as well as the actual Wu Shuai’s true inheritance. When he joins the fight against Spectral Soul, army ants gather and form a river of ants that sweeps toward Spectral Soul.
